title: Kenworth T909 FUPS high tensile fully polished Aluminium custom built Bullbar #62
description: Kenworth T909 high tensile fully polished aluminium custom built FUPS Bullbar 450mm deep style re-enforced main heavy duty channel. 100 mm diameter 6mm wall hi-tensile one piece pipe passing through drilled hi-tensile uprights for maximum protection. No butt welds. Flat bar mounts for driving lights to customer requirements. Heavy duty box uprights shown with combination LED indicator/daylight running/park lights in outer uprights. Light Bar and driving light mounts to customer spec. Reversible aluminium road train signs with KW logos on reverse side plus removable Oversize sign. Heavy duty backing plate with 38mm tow pin, Gussets from the top of the channel to the 1st. pipe for added strength. Flat bar to top of channel plus wombat flap. Helper springs assist with lifting the bar. Optional hi-tensile aluminium backing plate available on request giving up to an 80kg saving over the steel backing plate. Provision for front mudflaps. Bullbar can be custom built to your requirements.
